name: cptr
title: Cptr
description: Capture selections, web pages, screenshots, the clipboard and PDFs as plain folders, and find them again with full-text search.
author: aaltshuler

commands.name: capture-selection
commands.title: Capture Selection
commands.description: Save the selected text as a capture bundle

commands.name: capture-web
commands.title: Capture Web Page
commands.description: Archive the frontmost browser tab (or a given URL): text and a screenshot

commands.name: capture-region
commands.title: Capture Region
commands.description: Drag a screen region to capture; the text in it becomes searchable

commands.name: capture-screen
commands.title: Capture Full Screen
commands.description: Capture the main display; the text on it becomes searchable

commands.name: capture-clipboard
commands.title: Capture Clipboard
commands.description: Pin the current clipboard contents as a capture bundle

commands.name: capture-pdf
commands.title: Capture PDF
commands.description: Archive the PDFs selected in Finder, or the PDF open in the frontmost browser tab

commands.name: search-captures
commands.title: Search Captures
commands.description: Full-text search across all captures, with kind:, app: and tag: filters

commands.name: reprocess-captures
commands.title: Reprocess Captures
commands.description: Extract missing text and Markdown for existing captures, and settle ones left pending

preferences.name: capturesDir
preferences.title: Captures Folder
preferences.description: Where captures are saved, one folder per capture.

preferences.name: archiveSelectionPage
preferences.title: Selections
preferences.label: Also archive the page a selection came from
preferences.description: In a browser, save the page behind a selection as a second capture. Needs the Raycast Browser Extension.

preferences.name: recognizeText
preferences.title: Images
preferences.label: Recognize text in images
preferences.description: Read the text in screenshots, regions and clipboard images, on this Mac, so that search can find them.

preferences.name: keepPagePDF
preferences.title: Re-Fetched Pages
preferences.label: Keep the full-page PDF
preferences.description: A page that is not open in a readable tab is rendered by a headless browser. Its full-page PDF is the largest file in a capture; the text and a screenshot are kept either way.

preferences.name: browserApp
preferences.title: Browser for Re-Fetch
preferences.description: The Chromium browser that renders such pages. When empty: the first of Chrome, Chromium, Brave and Edge that is installed.
